pooler_config:
# pgagroal M2 variant (pipeline=transaction, ev_backend=io_uring)
# refs: CONFIGURATION.html, PIPELINES.html, ARCHITECTURE.html
[pgagroal]
host = 127.0.0.1
port = 6432
unix_socket_dir = /tmp
max_connections = 10
pipeline = transaction
ev_backend = io_uring
blocking_timeout = 0
idle_timeout = 0
max_connection_age = 0
validation = off
track_prepared_statements = off
nodelay = on
keep_alive = on
# allow_unknown_users = false is MANDATORY for the transaction
# pipeline (upstream validator FATALs otherwise; test/conf/01-02
# pin the same). benchuser is defined in the user vault
# (pgagroal_users.conf via -u), provisioned in setup().
allow_unknown_users = false
log_type = console
log_level = info
# backend server section (CONFIGURATION.html: sections other
# than [pgagroal] each configure one PostgreSQL backend;
# without one the pooler has no server to pool)
[primary]
host = 127.0.0.1
port = 5432
primary = on
# per-db pool (pgagroal_databases.conf): full
# DATABASE USER MAX_SIZE INITIAL_SIZE MIN_SIZE triple, all > 0
# (mandatory for the transaction pipeline); prefilled to max
# per the PIPELINES prefill recommendation.
# HBA (pgagroal_hba.conf, CI-only): scram-sha-256 so the
# vault-known benchuser authenticates against PostgreSQL
# itself (CONFIGURATION.html); `trust` cannot be used because
# the pooler would then hold no password for the SCRAM backend.
